subject: maths
question: For a regular polygon, the sum of the interior angles is 400% more than the sum of its exterior angles. Each interior angle of the polygon measures x°. What is the value of x?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum of interior angles = 400% more than sum of exterior angles

Each interior angle = x°

**Formula used:**

Sum of exterior angles = 360°

Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°

Each interior angle = ((n − 2) × 180) ÷ n

**Calculations:**

⇒ (n − 2) × 180 = 360 + 400% of 360

⇒ (n − 2) × 180 = 360 + 4 × 360

⇒ (n − 2) × 180 = 1800

⇒ n − 2 = 10

⇒ n = 12

Each interior angle: x = ((12 − 2) × 180) ÷ 12

⇒ x = (10 × 180) ÷ 12

⇒ x = 150°

**∴ x = 150°**
